paragon.note: Default is the Mixed Minion variant glyph order shown here. A Warrior-focused variant uses Warrior, Mage, Essence, Eliminator, Abyssal; a Mage-focused variant uses Mage, Essence, Deadraiser, Eliminator, Abyssal. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
